csv_project_name: AE Svc for Oshkosh Readiness Center - MVSC
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of Military Affairs requests selecting an A/E to provide design through construction administration services as indicated in the DFD Policy and Procedure Manual for Architects/Engineers and Consultants and the DFD AE Contract for Professional Services for the Oshkosh Readiness Center s Replace Motor Vehicle Storage Compound (MVSC) project. This project will consist of demolishing the existing MVSC including stripping the gravel and removing the fence and site lighting. The surrounding area will be cleared and grubbed to expand the footprint of the gravel pad creating a gravel drive adjacent to the new MVSC. The new MVSC will be surrounded by new fencing and will include new site lighting. Misc. site work items adjacent to the project area like sidewalk and signage will also be included.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering
